scope: source-scene validation only; strict train neighbor membership; validation inputs identical to old

primary_comparison.go_rule: >=1.5% ADE or >=2.5% FDE improvement, with >=10/15 wins in the same metric
primary_comparison.strong_go_rule: >=2% ADE AND >=3% FDE improvement, with >=12/15 paired runs improving both metrics

neighbor_split_audit.validation_policy: all currently observation-visible pedestrians, no future filtering

distance_statistics.policy: audit only; no radius or neighbor changes based on distance

latency.method: full uncached model incl shared frozen temporal encoder; exclusive GPU, zeros, eval/no_grad; 20 warmup +100 synchronized forwards; no data transfer

runs.training_method: frozen eval context cache, GPU-resident; seed-fixed shuffled sample batches; gradients only through new modules
runs.neighbor_policy: train-target-set-only for train; all observation-visible for val
